description.html: THE MOST INTENSE CRUSHER BASS EXPERIENCE YET Meet the next generation of Crusher. Crusher 720 takes everything you loved about Crusher Evo and turns it up with our most intense Crusher® Bass experience yet. Deeper and smoother than ever, the bass maintains Evo’s signature intensity while delivering more clarity, detail, and musicality. A redesigned Crusher wheel gives you more precise control over the bass, while THX® Spatial Audio creates a wider, more immersive listening experience. Deeper, softer ear cushions and an improved headband deliver a more comfortable fit, making it easier to listen longer. Add smarter controls, new features, and up to 65 hours of battery life for a Crusher experience that hits harder than ever.
